reviews.author: Devdas Patil
reviews.text:
​Food Quality: Generous portions, premium cuts, and zero compromise on freshness or spice levels.
​Service: Quick, attentive, and the staff had great recommendations for house specials.
​Ambience: Welcoming and clean—perfect for group dining or family dinners

reviews.author: Raj Patil
reviews.text:
I recently ordered from Persian Darbar through Swiggy, and overall, I had a great experience. The food arrived on time, was well packed, and was still hot when it reached me. The taste definitely lived up to the restaurant's reputation. The flavors were rich, the ingredients felt fresh, and the quality of the food was impressive.

The only issue I faced was with the portion size information on the Swiggy app. The quantity or serving size wasn't clearly mentioned, so I assumed the portion would be large. However, after receiving the order, I realized I had actually ordered a medium-sized portion. It would be very helpful if the restaurant clearly specified the quantity or approximate serving size for each item on the app. This would make it much easier for customers to choose the right port

reviews.author: SHREYA KARKERA
reviews.text: This is my most favourite place in Mumbai to have muglai food. I have been visiting this place since 12 years and this place has never ever disappointed me. Food ambience and service everything is good and this rating is specifically for Andheri branch not any other branch of Persian darbar.
